paper.title: Polymer-Based Shaping Strategy for Zeolite Templated Carbons (ZTC) and Their Metal Organic Framework (MOF) Composites for Improved Hydrogen Storage Properties

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet): ~60 cells, 0 numeric disputes; the scope selection (ZTC + two ZTC-composites in; pure MOF, pure polymer, polymer+MOF out) and the exclusion of the mass-weighted Estimated columns confirmed. Agent C adjudication: (1) composite synthesis_method 'other' -> 'template_synthesis' (corpus convention: a composite carries its carbon component's route; all 15 existing composite rows do); (2) pore_volume_method 'HK' -> 'unspecified' (the total pore volume is a single-point value at p/p0~0.99 per footnote d; corpus convention HYC-0032/0037); (3) ZTC HF/HCl purification added to the two composites (HYC-0029 precedent). All 3 rows Tier B.

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper labels these 'H2 uptake'/'H2 adsorbed at 77 K and 1 bar'; 'excess' appears only as 'excess furfuryl alcohol' and 'Total' only in 'Total pore vol.'
notes.porevol: total_pore_volume_cm3_g is a single-point total at p/p0~0.99 (Table 1 footnote d: 'Total pore volume determined from H-K analysis by uptake at p/p ~0.99'); Horvath-Kawazoe is a micropore-size model and does not yield a 0.99 total, so pore_volume_method=unspecified (corpus convention for single-point totals); micropore_surface_area_m2_g is the t-plot micropore area (footnote c)
notes.estimated: the Table 1 'Estimated BET SSA' and 'Estimated H2 uptake' columns are mass-weighted predictions from the pristine components, not measurements, and are not extracted
notes.method: N2 and H2 sorption to 1 bar on a Micromeritics ASAP 2020 HD (static volumetric) at 77 K; degassed 8 h at 200 C under vacuum; measurement_method=volumetric_sieverts by instrument identity (HYC-0022 precedent); sample mass and blank/calibration not stated
notes.scope: pristine UiO-66(Zr) (a MOF), pristine PIM-1 (a polymer) and PIM-1/80 wt% UiO-66(Zr) (polymer+MOF, no carbon) are not carbon nanomaterials and are excluded; the ZTC and the two ZTC-containing composites are in scope
notes.composite: a ZTC-containing composite is class=composite (corpus convention): it holds the zeolite-templated carbon plus a PIM-1 binder (and UiO-66 MOF in the three-filler composite); synthesis_method is template_synthesis after the ZTC route; material_description gives the component fractions
notes.ztc: zeolite-13X-templated carbon by furfuryl-alcohol impregnation and ethylene CVD, carbonised 900 C; HF then HCl washing removes the zeolite template (purification)
notes.ternary: the three-filler composite (40 wt% ZTC) is a borderline carbon/MOF composite, included under manual section 7.2 (tag and include borderline carbon-MOF composites)
notes.onebar: Chahine caveat (section 5): 1-bar cryogenic rows score a by-hand chahine 1 (saturation bound inapplicable at 1 bar); Tier B either way

S1.label: ZTC
S1.material_description: pristine zeolite-13X-templated carbon (ZTC): furfuryl-alcohol impregnation, ethylene CVD, carbonised 900 C, zeolite removed by HF/HCl
S1.purification_method: HF (10%) wash 24 h then reflux in HCl (10%) 24 h to remove the zeolite 13X template

S2.label: PIM-1/80 wt% ZTC
S2.material_description: shaped composite monolith of 80 wt% ZTC and 20 wt% PIM-1 polymer binder (solvent blending in TCE)
S2.purification_method: the ZTC filler was purified by HF (10%) wash 24 h then reflux in HCl (10%) 24 h to remove the zeolite 13X template

S3.label: PIM-1/UiO-66(Zr)/ZTC (80 wt%)
S3.material_description: shaped composite monolith of 20 wt% PIM-1, 40 wt% ZTC and 40 wt% UiO-66(Zr) MOF (solvent blending in TCE)
S3.purification_method: the ZTC filler was purified by HF (10%) wash 24 h then reflux in HCl (10%) 24 h to remove the zeolite 13X template
